zh: 安全强度：以比特衡量、破解保护难度的度量。
经典安全强度：不考虑量子算法的强度口径。
TDEA：三重数据加密算法，常称 Triple DES。
密钥长度：与安全强度共同决定的参数位数。
national security system：需另行批准才适用的系统类别。
en: Security strength: a bit measure of the difficulty of subverting protection.
Classical security strength: the strength measure ignoring quantum attacks.
TDEA: the Triple Data Encryption Algorithm, commonly Triple DES.
Key length: the bit size judged together with strength.
Deprecation: the announced phase-out of an algorithm.
National security system: the category needing separate approval.
